messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: runAPP (R session abortion)
parts:
Hi,

I just started to learn "Shiny". However, the error message occurred when I tried to run app (e.g. runAPP ("example")). 
The error message is shown on Rstudio (Version 0.98.501) as "R session Aborted, R encountered a fatal error. The session was terminated".

I also tried to run app on R console (R version  3.0.2). The same termination message also appeared.

Could you give me some suggestion to fix the problem? Really appreciate that.

Thanks.
Jia

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: runAPP (R session abortion)
parts:
Can you try running this:

install.packages(c("Rcpp", "httpuv", "shiny"))

Then restart your R session, and try again? The problem is likely that httpuv was built against a later version of Rcpp than you have installed; installing all three packages should ensure you have compatible versions.

Thanks...
